card.name: Linking words before coma
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "and", "by" or "including" that come right before the word coma or shock. They appear in lists of severe outcomes in overdose or emergency text.

modes.label: Range up to coma
modes.description: The word "to" ends a severity range that is about to reach coma.
modes.example: central nervous system depression ranging from drowsiness<< to>> coma.

modes.label: Last item in a list
modes.description: "and" or "including" sits before the final severe outcome in a list of symptoms.
modes.example: seizures, coma,<< and>> death can result.

modes.label: Before coma in a condition name
modes.description: A linking or modifying word comes before a coma-type condition.
modes.example: Myxedema coma is a life-threatening emergency characterized<< by>> poor circulation and hypometabolism,
